thread:
Noah Park: Follow-up from the brief tail spike at 02:05 UTC. Root cause looks like KV write stalls when ingestion batches exceed 1k items. Proposing a temporary SLO concession and a short mitigation plan.

Ivy Chen: Numbers? How bad did p95/p99 move?

Noah Park: p95 from 110ms -> 260ms, p99 from 190ms -> 420ms during the 6m window. Throughput stayed steady but queueing increased. Estimated extra burn ~0.6% of monthly budget if left unaddressed.

Marco Diaz: Short plan: 1) temp p95 bump 150ms for 48h (ops apply, auto-revert) 2) reduce ingestion max_batch 1200->800 and add jitter (Marco, 24h) 3) add cache-write probe at 30s cadence (Ivy, 48h) 4) open ticket to investigate fsync behavior (Noah, 7d).

ops-bot: Created ticket INF-4780 "temp-slo-bump & ingest-batch caps" and linked thread.

Ivy Chen: For alerting, propose a 5m window on p95>0.16 and a page on p99>0.3 sustained 10m. Will add a grafana tile for batch-size distribution.

Marco Diaz: I'll open the batching PR with canary rollout and perf results today.

Noah Park: Recurring pattern check: I scanned last 90 days, found 2 similar micro-spikes. I'll add a recurrence-watch to auto-open mitigation if >=2 in 30d. Owner: Noah, ETA 7d.

Ivy Chen: Sounds good. I'll wire the probe and dashboard.

Marco Diaz: PR incoming.

Noah Park: Thanks all — leaving this thread for updates, will close after PR + INF tickets referenced.
